The Complete Worldbook

Reading the margins: each regional chapter carries the compiler’s introduction and a four-voice exchange about a practical choice. Their Ledger links lead to clues and procedures for using the Ninth Words. The speakers disagree; their notes are approaches to test, not rulings that override the regional text.

Preparing your next session

Start with Run a region: quick reference, then choose the chapter you need. Each regional chapter opens with a playable campaign seed and three-clock example. Keep Three Clocks at the table handy instead of tracking every regional timer at once.

A Gazetteer of the Known Realms

How to use this book

This is the broad setting gazetteer in Travel. You can prepare a session by learning one region; the whole world is a reference to return to, not a reading assignment before play.

  • Understand the guide’s voices: Preface: Four Voices at One Table, then The Cartomancer's Compass. These chapters introduce how the book presents its world.
  • Understand everyday pressures: On Obligation and Trade. Read this for the relationships and exchanges behind regional life.
  • Choose the opening region: The Amaranthine Sea & Northern Shores. This is one possible starting point. The contents also offer northern, eastern, southern, and other realms; choose the one your campaign needs.
  • Connect places and prepare play: World Travel & Gateways, then Story Beat (SB) Menus. Consult these alongside the relevant core procedure when preparing journeys and consequences.
